newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms slightly on Slovnaft gains.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms slightly on Slovnaft gains.

text.p: Trading of major Slovak shares was quiet on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Wednesday, with gains to issue of the oil refinery Slovnaft helping to boost the 16-share SAX index 0.81 to 206.48 points.
Slovnaft closed up six crowns at 1,006 crowns and brokers said they expect the issue to continue to push higher.
"A pack of some 200,000 Slovnaft shares is wandering around the market, attracting the interest and keeping the (issue's) price high," Bohus Betko of ING Barings said.
"I expect Slovnaft's price to keep around the 1,000 level at least until this pack is placed," he added.

Steel maker VSZ's average price gained 0.8 percent, but the shares closed unchanged at 725 crowns. "Activity around VSZ is reviving at the moment. I think there may also a reasonable (large) pack appear soon."
Overal volume increased to 204,788 shares, from 35,302 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover rose to 56.81 million crowns, from 28.72 million.
